parts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate SIX distinct consecutive turntable viewpoints of the exact SAME garment in the reference. Reference is the design identity sheet, LEFT front, RIGHT back. Minimal No Pocket Hoodie, pale cream cotton interlock #dbd2bf, olive hood opening binding and rib cuffs #57634d, plain STRAIGHT cream hem, relaxed long sleeves. NO pockets, NO kangaroo pouch, NO drawstrings, NO zipper, NO ribbed waist. Hood naturally folded down on the back view, not sticking straight upward. Olive small ML at left chest, olive MiloShopHand script upper back. Preserve this minimal pocketless construction EXACTLY as reference. Create exactly THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, 6 equal-sized cells, native 1536x1024 or larger (512px per cell). Frames0-5 in row-major order: 0 EXACT FRONT,15,30,45,60,75degrees. Slowly turn from the front towards the wearer's left side. Chest logo progressively foreshortens, back script is not visible. Rotate the physical garment about the UPRIGHT VERTICAL Y axis only. Camera fixed and level; no pitch, roll, leaning or flat-picture tilting. Same entire garment centered and fully visible in every cell, same scale, soft cloth folds, sleeve pose and lighting. Thin sides must really appear narrow. Logo perspective must be natural, never mirror text. Uniform pale warm ivory studio background, soft even editorial light. Empty garment, no body, mannequin, hanger, stand, labels, angle numbers, borders, gutters, grid lines or watermark. Keep 5% margin in each cell. Match the reference's fabric, colour, cut, seams, drape, all pockets and closures. Do not simplify or redesign the garment.
